zoe: Heads up  BeaconCorp wants a drop-in replacement for CompetitorX. Main asks: prompt parity, streaming, pricing delta, and security questionnaire. What are must-have checks?
mike: Must-have: header/auth mapping, streaming compatibility, tokenization differences, stop-sequence semantics, and cost modelling.
rana: I'll prototype an adapter shim. CompetitorX uses SSE with `event:chunk`. We use chunked JSON lines. Example proxy snippet to translate SSE->chunk: 
```js
// pseudo
const sse = new EventSource(cxUrl);
sse.addEventListener('chunk', e => { const d = JSON.parse(e.data); clientSocket.write(JSON.stringify(d)); });
```
sec-bot: Security intake created: INT-2024-003 assigned to @rana and @zoe. Please add KMS & SAML responses.
zoe: Client does ~2M tokens/mo. Estimate pricing delta with our batching+cache?
mike: Roughly -10% to -25% depending on caching. Need their traces to be precise. I'll run tokenization comparison and batching sim.
rana: Action items:
- @rana: adapter shim + README (headers + SSE->JSON mapping) - 24h
- @mike: token delta + cost model once logs are uploaded
- @zoe: compile enterprise Q&A packet and flag VPC peering & mTLS as potential blockers for Hosted
zoe: They uploaded logs to the S3 link. Mike, can you run the 1k prompt sample today?
mike: On it. Will post summary in this thread.
